high_level_description: The image depicts a woman standing indoors against a plain beige wall with a light wooden floor. She is wearing an elegant black dress that fits closely to her figure, accentuating her silhouette. The dress features long sleeves and a high neckline. Around her shoulders, she has a luxurious white fur stole that adds a touch of opulence to her outfit. In her right hand, she holds a glass containing what appears to be a cocktail or a similar beverage. The drink has a light-colored liquid with ice cubes and possibly some garnish on the rim of the glass.
